slides.headline: 6 PROMPTS THAT BUILD YOUR 90-DAY CASH RUNWAY TONIGHT
slides.image_prompt: Dario Amodei in orange hard hat, triumphant grin, arms resting on fortress wall of stacked bills; glowing copper neon Claude logo behind; documentary photo style, electric orange against navy.

slides.headline: 1) FIND THE CLIENTS WHO COST MORE THAN THEY PAY
slides.body:
Most owners have one client who costs more than they pay.

"Here are my clients, what they pay, and hours I spend on each: [list]. Rank by profit per hour. Who should I fire?"

slides.headline: 2) MODEL WHAT HAPPENS IF YOU LOSE 30% OF REVENUE
slides.body:
Most businesses have no plan if revenue falls 30%.

"I make $[X]/month. My costs are [list]. Tell me what to cut if revenue drops 20%, 40%, then 60%."
slides.image_prompt: A padlocked glass storefront door, dark empty interior visible through smeared glass — chairs upturned on tables, no lights — a large red downward arrow painted on the window; close exterior shot, overcast grey light; no readable text; documentary photo, 35mm, film grain; accent: red arrow against cold grey.

slides.headline: 3) DRAFT A PRICE INCREASE EMAIL CLIENTS WON'T HATE
slides.body:
Raising prices loses fewer clients than you think. The email is the trick.

"My clients pay $[X]/month. I need to raise it to $[Y]. Write an email that explains why and keeps them."

slides.headline: $40,000,000,000,000
slides.body: That is the official US national debt today. Every dollar your business earns is worth less than it was a year ago.

slides.headline: 4) AUDIT EVERY SUBSCRIPTION YOUR BUSINESS PAYS FOR
slides.body:
The average small business pays for software nobody uses. This finds it.

"Here are my recurring subscriptions: [list]. Find which ones overlap, what to cut, and free alternatives for each."
slides.image_prompt: A credit card flat on a dark wood desk, torn-paper squares marked with bold red X symbols scattered around it, a red pen resting across the pile; overhead flat lay, dramatic warm studio light; no readable text; documentary photo, 35mm, film grain; accent: signal red pen against deep walnut.

slides.headline: 5) BUILD A 90-DAY CASH RUNWAY PLAN TONIGHT
slides.body:
You probably cannot name how many days of cash your business has.

"I make $[X]/month and spend $[Y]/month. Rank my costs by priority. How many days of cash do I have?"
slides.image_prompt: A candle burned to its last stub of wick, small amber flame casting a tight circle of light on dark wood, a single gold coin resting beside the base; pitch-black background, tight close shot; no readable text; documentary photo, 35mm, film grain; accent: warm amber flame against black.

slides.headline: 6) WRITE A PITCH FOR A GOVERNMENT CONTRACT
slides.body:
Small businesses win federal contracts every month. Most have fewer than 20 employees.

"I run a [type] business. Write a capability statement for a federal contract in [industry] that makes us sound qualified."

slides.headline: SAVE THIS: ALL 6 PROMPTS THAT DEBT-PROOF YOUR BUSINESS
slides.body:
1. Find loss-making clients
2. Model a 20/40/60% revenue drop
3. Write a price increase email
4. Audit subscriptions
5. Build 90-day cash plan
6. Pitch a government contract

Daily AI + real skills

caption:
Swipe through all 6. 🔒 These are the AI prompts that find hidden losses, fix your pricing, and build a financial floor before things get harder.

Six prompts: find the clients costing you more than they pay, model what happens if revenue drops 20%, 40%, or 60%, draft a price increase email your clients won't hate, audit every recurring subscription your business pays for, build a 90-day cash runway plan tonight, and write a federal capability statement to win a government contract.

US national debt crossed $40 trillion today. That means sticky inflation, tighter credit, and shrinking margins for small businesses. Build the financial floor now.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: US Treasury, Anthropic

#AItools #smallbusiness #businessgrowth #entrepreneur #artificialintelligence
pinned_comment: Which of these are you running tonight? Slide 7 is the one most owners skip, and it's usually the one that saves the business.

candidates: YOUR BUSINESS IS LOSING MONEY. 6 PROMPTS THAT FIX IT
6 AI PROMPTS THAT MAKE YOUR BUSINESS IMPOSSIBLE TO KILL
6 PROMPTS THAT FIND WHERE YOUR BUSINESS BLEEDS MONEY
6 PROMPTS THAT TURN A $40 TRILLION CRISIS INTO CASH
hook_tournament.why: "Bleeds money" is visceral and specific—you actually feel the problem and want to know the answer. "Impossible to kill" is just corporate hype that sounds fake.

candidates: 6 SPOTS YOUR BUSINESS BLEEDS MONEY MOST OWNERS OVERLOOK
6 PROMPTS THAT BUILD YOUR 90-DAY CASH RUNWAY TONIGHT
6 PROMPTS THAT DEBT-PROOF YOUR BUSINESS BEFORE YOUR ACCOUNTANT BILLS YOU
6 PROMPTS THAT FIND WHERE YOUR BUSINESS BLEEDS MONEY
hook_sharpen.why: 'TONIGHT' is immediate and makes you feel like you could actually do this right now—way stronger than 'before accountant bills.' '90-day cash runway' is a concrete metric you understand, while 'debt-proof' is just a vague promise.
